column1: # PARITY.tsv -- C-to-OM retirement ledger (REVIEW-LESSONS.md "C to OM migration"; checked by
# One `c` row per C file that a change deletes, or whose same-stem .om it adds or edits outside
# tests/. Columns (tab separated): kind, C path, ref (live = in the tree; else the commit that
# holds the deleted file), the make target holding the C-vs-OM differential (- when none),
# the functions it covers (every function the C file defines with external linkage that the
# differential reaches and compares; - when none), and every other such function as
# Covered means reached by the differential's corpus on the C reference and compared: measured
# with gcov on the C reference build (test-visor-effect-parity: 100% of visor_effect_request.c
# lines; visor_world.c: the unattached view only, the one view omega can show, pinned by
# file has no other external function (gen-protocol: main, byte-identical C and OM runs).
# A row with target - is a C file this change retired WITHOUT a differential in the tree; each
# reason says what checks the replacement instead. These rows are the open qualification debt.
# `check` rows (kind, file, deleted C stem, -, -, reason): an nm/objdump/grep line on retired C
# that is allowed without an OM scan.
